page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No marginal notes. Running head at top left, page number at top right, catchword "ad" at bottom right.

main_text.p: διασπορᾶς Πόντου[?], Γαλατίας &c. Quod intelligi de διασπορᾷ sive Assyriacâ decem tribuum, sive Babylonicâ reliquarum, sive Antiochenâ, furente Epiphane ac saeviente in Iudaeorum gentem; sive, ut alii, Claudianâ Act. xviii. 1. dum Iudaeos assiduè tumultuantes Româ Claudius expulit; quanquam verius de generaliori dispersione tribuum, non novissimâ illa ac quorundam Romae agentium. Cl. Salmasius dispersionem intelligit non coactam, sed voluntariam, non exulum sed colonorum partem generalis illius dispersionis quâ Iudaei per totum orbem dispersi inter gentes agitabant, de Hellenist. Quaest. v. III. Ex Iacobo idem intelligimus, cujus inscriptio gemina: τοῖς ἐντὸς διασπορᾶς, i.e. ut ipse addit exegeticè, τοῖς δώδεκα φυλαῖς, Iudaeorum nempe tribubus, pervariis Orientis partes, utique minoris Asiae provincias dispersis. IV. Lucem hic accenditur Historia Act. 11. ubi ex illis ipsis locis, Cappadociâ, Ponto, Asiâ &c. recensentur Iudaei conversi ad Christianam fidem, & Petri imprimis oratione affecti, ad

page.notes: The Greek on the first line and in "τοῖς ἐντὸς διασπορᾶς" is set in a cursive, partly blurred type; the first word and accents of the opening Greek line are doubtful and marked [?]. The word "Quaest." and "III." are run into the text on the same line. "Act. 11." is read as printed; the numeral is uncertain. The word "ad" at the foot is the catchword. Several words in the middle of the text are blurred by ink spread, but are readable.
